assertion_results.text: States which pricing tier receives emphasis and by what visual mechanism
assertion_results.evidence: The output states: "Make the middle tier the visual anchor" and identifies the "Recommended tier treatment" as "Slightly larger card (5–10% scale difference)", "Elevated position", "Stronger border/shadow", "Accent background or gradient", and "'Most popular' badge".

assertion_results.text: Maintains structural consistency across the three tiers while differentiating emphasis
assertion_results.evidence: The component hierarchy shows all three tiers using PricingCard with shared elements: "TierHeader", "Price", "Description", "FeatureList", and CTA elements. Differentiation is shown by Pro having "PopularBadge" and "PrimaryCTAButton" while Starter and Enterprise use supporting/contact CTAs.

assertion_results.text: FAQ treatment is deliberately de-emphasized relative to pricing tiers with a stated reason
assertion_results.evidence: The output places "FAQSection" after "PricingGrid" and states: "Place FAQ after pricing, not before." It gives the reason as the decision flow: "What are my options? → Which plan fits me? → What about my concerns? → Conversion".
